name: Inductive Bio
description:
Inductive Bio’s absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion, and toxicity (ADMET) models predict the chemical and pharmacokinetic properties that determine whether a molecule can become a viable drug. When these predictions are surfaced directly in conversation, scientists can evaluate compounds, triage ideas, and prioritize which molecules to synthesize, without leaving their existing workflow.

Through this MCP server, users can access Inductive Bio’s models for the physicochemical properties LogD (lipophilicity) and pKa (acid/base ionization), key drivers of solubility and permeability. 

Inductive’s full suite of models spans all tiers of ADMET assays, including microsomal stability, efflux, CYP inhibition, brain penetration, hERG inhibition, and more. Models are fine-tuned to each customer’s chemical space to advance predictive performance. To access the full suite, reach out to Inductive Bio here: https://www.inductive.bio/book-a-demo.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Inductive Bio to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Inductive Bio to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.inductive.bio/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Inductive Bio MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Inductive Bio provides these MCP tools: list_available_models and predict_properties.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Inductive Bio?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Inductive Bio in life-sciences on the Manufact MCP catalog include AdisInsight, Boltz API, Helix GenoSphere, LatchBio, and Owkin.

_published_faq.name: Does Inductive Bio MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Inductive Bio requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Inductive Bio is developed by Inductive Bio. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
